checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does DataColumnSidecarsByRange response enforce strict (slot, column_index) ordering?

reachability.notes: Ordering is a server-side guarantee. Receiving nodes may rely on ordering for efficient processing. Out-of-order responses could cause syncing failures or incorrect data availability conclusions.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the DataColumnSidecarsByRange request handler in the P2P layer (edge tb-003). 2. Review the response generation logic to verify sidecars are sorted by (slot, column_index) before sending. 3. Trace through the code path from request receipt to response construction. 4. Verify that for any two consecutive sidecars S1 and S2: either S1.slot < S2.slot, OR (S1.slot == S2.slot AND S1.column_index < S2.column_index). 5. Test by requesting a range that spans multiple slots with multiple columns per slot. 6. Verify ordering is maintained when sidecars are retrieved from different sources (cache, database, network). 7. Check edge cases: empty responses, single sidecar responses, responses at slot boundaries.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0037, Trust Boundary: tb-003. This is a post-condition on the server's response behavior. Clients may rely on this ordering for efficient processing of data availability checks. Violation could cause syncing failures or incorrect data availability conclusions.
